notes: Images are generated hand-painted art with explicitly authorized local alpha cleanup/cropping/downsampling/mirroring/assembly.
Standalone layer files preserve native cropped pixels; assembled previews are not new model generations.
Layer anchor positions and sizes are authored art coordinates. Texture atlas packing, game-unit scale, animation/recoil and actual Mindustry loading have not been tested.
Optional base/joint overlays are incorporated in painted body/segment layers; runtime adapter may omit optional regions rather than duplicate opaque joints.
Color/energy beams, projectiles, water trails and procedural movement remain runtime effects; this unit kit supplies static body and motion/weapon parts.
